mapper.select: SELECT note_id as id, build_username, content, tag, build_date, refresh_date, is_deleted, is_anon, is_allow_comment, like_num, comment_num, read_num FROM note WHERE note.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY note.refresh_date DESC

SELECT n.note_id as id, n.build_username, n.content, n.tag, n.build_date, n.refresh_date, n.is_deleted, n.is_anon, n.is_allow_comment, n.like_num, n.comment_num, n.read_num, CASE WHEN nl.username IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM note n LEFT JOIN note_like nl ON n.note_id = nl.note_id AND nl.username = #{username} WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.refresh_date DESC

SELECT note_id as id, build_username, content, tag, build_date, refresh_date, is_deleted, is_anon, is_allow_comment, like_num, comment_num, read_num FROM note WHERE is_deleted = 0 HAVING MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{searchString} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{searchString} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC, refresh_date DESC

SELECT n.note_id as id, n.build_username, n.content, n.tag, n.build_date, n.refresh_date, n.is_deleted, n.is_anon, n.is_allow_comment, n.like_num, n.comment_num, n.read_num, CASE WHEN nl.username IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM note n LEFT JOIN note_like nl ON n.note_id = nl.note_id AND nl.username = #{username} WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 HAVING MATCH(n.content) AGAINST(#{searchString} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ORDER BY MATCH(n.content) AGAINST(#{searchString} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC, n.refresh_date DESC

SELECT note_id as id, build_username, content, tag, build_date, refresh_date, is_deleted, is_anon, is_allow_comment, like_num, comment_num, read_num FROM note WHERE note.is_deleted = 0 AND note.tag = #{tag} ORDER BY note.refresh_date ASC;

SELECT n.note_id as id, n.build_username, n.content, n.tag, n.build_date, n.refresh_date, n.is_deleted, n.is_anon, n.is_allow_comment, n.like_num, n.comment_num, n.read_num, CASE WHEN nl.username IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM note n LEFT JOIN note_like nl ON n.note_id = nl.note_id AND nl.username = #{username} WHERE n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.tag = #{tag} ORDER BY n.refresh_date ASC

SELECT note_id AS id, build_username, content, tag, build_date, refresh_date, is_deleted, is_anon, is_allow_comment, like_num, comment_num, read_num FROM note WHERE note_id = #{noteId} AND is_deleted = 0;

SELECT n.note_id AS id, n.build_username, n.content, n.tag, n.build_date, n.refresh_date, n.is_deleted, n.is_anon, n.is_allow_comment, n.like_num, n.comment_num, n.read_num, CASE WHEN nl.username IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isLikedByCurrentUser FROM note n LEFT JOIN note_like nl ON n.note_id = nl.note_id AND nl.username = #{username} WHERE n.note_id = #{noteId} AND n.is_deleted = 0
